name: Osananajimi
source:
At the end of a short spring break hero finds a childhood photo of him and five girls in the neighborhood. There is also a small key to the time capsule beside the photo. He chooses to use the time capsule to reunite with his memories of those days... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在短暫的春假結束時，主角發現了一張他和附近五個女孩的童年照片。照片旁邊還有一把時間膠囊的小鑰匙。他選擇利用時間膠囊，與當年的記憶重逢…… 

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-october-2000-baldr-bullet.html]vndbreview[/url]］
